Name: Zaccur, Son of Asaph
Summary: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph according to the order of the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:2; 1 Chronicles 25:10: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph according to the order of the king.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zaccur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
